The AI Pivot That American Bitcoin Missed
While many publicly traded Bitcoin miners have benefited this year by expanding into AI-focused data centers, American Bitcoin has remained committed to its cryptocurrency mining strategy.

tweets.author: context776.bsky.social
tweets.text: On July 1, 2026, American Bitcoin shares fell to $0.61, marking a new all-time low. The 1-for-15 reverse split executed the following day reduced outstanding shares from about 1.09 billion to 73 million, aiming to boost the share price and preserve Nasdaq listing compliance.
